notes.title: 1.2.1 release
notes.content:
This update has two main features, along with some fixes. 

First, it makes it ready for the upcoming donator DLC which is here for the ones who wants to show their appreciation for the game. :)

Second, a glitch within steam made the achievements not working anymore. Sadly the problem isn't corrected at the time. But while waiting for a fix, an achievements menu has been added. This will let you see the achievements you unlocked in game. To activate the menu, just finish the game once with any route. (note that it doesn't sync with your steam achievements)

It is suggested you delete your previously saved game to make this feature work. To do this, delete the following folder:
- Windows: [i]%APPDATA%/RenPy/kwk[/i]
- Mac OS: [i]~/Library/RenPy/kwk[/i]
- Linux: [i]~/.renpy/kwk[/i]
